name: SensitivityLabel
description: Represents a wrapper object for accessing sensitivity label on the active document.
remarks: SensitivityLabel applied on a document requires the use of policy defined by organization administrator. The organization is identified by using an identity of an Office Account signed into Office.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SensitivityLabel object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SensitivityLabel object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SensitivityLabel object. Read-only.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Gets the current label information that exists on the document for the user.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.signature: SetLabel(LabelInfo As LabelInfo, Context As Object)
methods.description: Sets the label information on the document for the user.

parameters.name: LabelInfo
parameters.description: The label information that needs to be set on the document.

parameters.name: Context
parameters.description: A caller defined context that can be returned with LabelChanged event to help ensure that the event was raised because of the SetLabel call.

methods.name: CreateLabelInfo
methods.description: Creates a new LabelInfo object that can be passed to SetLabel method.

events.name: LabelChanged
events.signature: LabelChanged(OldLabelInfo As LabelInfo, NewLabelInfo As LabelInfo, HResult As Long, Context As Object)
events.description: Raised when a Label is changed on the document.

parameters.name: OldLabelInfo
parameters.description: Previous label information that existed on the document.

parameters.name: NewLabelInfo
parameters.description: New label information that was applied on the document.

parameters.name: HResult
parameters.description: An integer representing the error code.

parameters.name: Context
parameters.description: The _context_ object that was set with SetLabel call.
